description: Enhanced component redesigns with unique shapes, modern positioning, and eye-catching layouts. Transform each section (Hero, Nav, About, Services, Projects, Certificates, Contact, Footer) from generic AI template to distinctive design while keeping all content intact.
steps: Hero section (css/layout.css, css/components-enhanced.css): Added diagonal split background using clip-path on ::before pseudo-element with gradient overlay, asymmetric offset with floating geometric shapes (pentagon, circle) positioned absolutely with spin and float animations

Navigation (css/layout.css): Transformed navbar to glass-morphism design with backdrop-filter: blur(24px), gradient border-bottom using border-image, added nav-link hover effect with expanding pill-shaped background glow and centered underline

About section (css/components-enhanced.css): Redesigned .about-img-frame with irregular organic shape using border-radius: 60% 40% 70% 30% / 40% 60% 30% 70%, added overlapping decorative frame (.about-deco) with offset position and matching organic border-radius, skills grid enhanced with asymmetric layout using grid-column span variations

Services section (css/layout.css, css/components-enhanced.css): Transformed .services-grid to use grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)) for bento-grid inspired responsive layout, added diagonal gradient top border and right side accent on hover with transform effects

Projects section (css/components-enhanced.css): Redesigned .project-card with tilted image container (transform: rotate(-2deg) on .project-img-placeholder), added colored 4px gradient accent bar on left edge via ::after pseudo-element, asymmetric padding for .project-info (padding-left: 1.8rem)

Certificates section (css/components-enhanced.css): Transformed .cert-card to polaroid-style design with white border simulation using box-shadow inset (inset 0 0 0 8px white), rotate alternate cards using :nth-child(odd) rotate(1deg) and :nth-child(even) rotate(-1deg), added ribbon-style .cert-badge positioned with gradient background

Contact section (css/components-enhanced.css): Redesigned .contact-form inputs with neumorphic styling using inset box-shadow (inset 2px 2px 5px for depth), enhanced focus state with combined inset shadow, outer glow ring, and elevated shadow effect

Timeline (css/components-enhanced.css): Replaced .timeline line with animated gradient using background-size + timelineFlow animation, transformed .timeline-dot to hexagon shape using clip-path: polygon(30% 0%, 70% 0%, 100% 30%, 100% 70%, 70% 100%, 30% 100%, 0% 70%, 0% 30%), added glowPulse animation for pulsing effect

Footer (css/layout.css): Added wave separator SVG using ::before pseudo-element with data URI SVG path, centered content with max-width, added subtle grid pattern background using ::after with linear-gradient repeating pattern (30px × 30px grid)
All HTML content preserved - only CSS modifications made for visual transformation

findings:
Successfully implemented all component redesigns with unique shapes and modern positioning:

1. Hero Section: Diagonal gradient clip-path background (polygon 0 0, 100% 0, 100% 60%, 0 80%), floating pentagon and circle decorations with rotation/float animations

2. Navigation: Enhanced glass-morphism with 65% opacity background, gradient border-image, pill-shaped hover backgrounds with glow effects

3. About: Organic irregular border-radius (60% 40% 70% 30% / 40% 60% 30% 70%) on image frame, decorative offset frame with blobMorph animation, asymmetric skills grid with varied column spans

4. Services: Bento-grid layout using auto-fit minmax(280px, 1fr), gradient top border reveal, diagonal gradient overlays on hover

5. Projects: Image containers rotated -2deg, 4px gradient left accent bar, asymmetric padding (left: 1.8rem)

6. Certificates: Polaroid design with inset white border (8px), alternating rotation (±1deg), ribbon-style gradient badges

7. Contact: Neumorphic inputs with inset shadows (2px 2px 5px inset), enhanced focus with multi-layer shadow (inset + outer glow + elevation)

8. Timeline: Animated gradient line (timelineFlow animation), hexagon dots via clip-path polygon, glowPulse animation

9. Footer: SVG wave separator via data URI, 30px grid pattern background with linear-gradient

All content preserved, only visual CSS enhancements applied. Design successfully transforms from generic AI template to distinctive, modern portfolio with unique geometric shapes and motion graphics.
